title: South Florida Nightlife This Weekend
igCaption:
Boats, rooftops, clubs and live music are on the South Florida weekend lineup.

Sources: NBC 6 South Florida, Data Portuaria, Miami New Times, Haute Living, The Miami Guide

#Miami #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #Nightlife

scenes.text: This weekend starts on the water, then moves to rooftops, clubs, and live music around South Florida.
Start with Sail La Vie in Miami. NBC 6 says the weekend celebrates Black sailing culture on Saturday, November 7.
scenes.caption: Start with Sail La Vie in Miami. NBC 6 says the weekend celebrates Black sailing culture on Saturday, Nov. 7.

scenes.text: Fort Lauderdale gets the other boat headline. Data Portuaria says Legend of the Seas homeports there on its first U.S. visit.
scenes.caption: Fort Lauderdale gets the other boat headline. Data Portuaria says Legend of the Seas homeports there on its first U.S. visit.

scenes.text: Then watch Club Space downtown. Miami New Times says Space teased a GTA VI transformation called the Vault on Wednesday, November 4. If you end up at Space, open NEAR and see who else was there.

scenes.text: For live music, keep Miami on the board. Haute Living published its guide to the best live music venues in Miami on September 25, covering jazz clubs and supper clubs.

scenes.text: Wynwood also has the party runway warming up. The Miami Guide published its Art Basel and Miami Art Week parties guide on October 1.

scenes.text: Which stop would you start with: boat, rooftop, club, or live music? After a night like this, it’s easy to remember a face and not a name, and NEAR shows you who those people were.
